div.div:
Knows
• Campsite and author, rating, review text, and timestamps.
• Thread replies, parent references, and account reactions.
• Unsaved rating/reply input and operation state.
Does
• Display reviews, rating summaries, replies, and reactions.
• Create or update an account’s campsite rating.
• Validate ratings from 1–5 and nonblank replies.
• Ensure replies belong to the same review thread.
• Set, replace, or remove an account’s reaction.
• Preserve input after failures.

div.div:
Knows
• Current identity/account and selected interface role.
• Initialization state and foreground-work lifecycle.
Does
• Show workspaces allowed by the account’s roles.
• Switch workspaces while keeping the same account identity.
• Request owner capability through AccountRepository; never grant
ADMIN.
• Bootstrap device identity and retrieve or initialize the account.
• Expose session state, initialization errors, and retry actions.
• Arrange foreground execution of resumable work after initialization.
• Establish or retrieve device-linked identity without username/password
login.
• Supply the account ID and report initialization failures.
• notification-token registration/removal

• ID
• Site details
• Creation/published time
• If it was removed
• Campsite ID, owner ID, publication/removal state.

price, and rules.
Does
• Stores data related to a campsite
• Represent a campsite listing and its editable details.
• Validate required fields, capacity, price, and timezone.
• Derive whether the listing is published and active.
• Retrieve and observe listings and availability.
• Create, edit, and publish owner listings.
• Offer or withdraw nights while protecting booked nights.

div.div:
Knows
• Search text, applied filters, published results, and rating summaries.
• Loading/empty/failure state and selected campsite.
• Account preferences and optional device location/map state.
Applied location, stay dates, guest count, tags/amenities, and nearby
radius.
Does
• Apply search, location, stay-date, and guest-capacity filters.
• Present matching summaries and open campsite details.
• Assemble ratings and calendar availability through repositories.
• Optional WOW: show nearby map/radius, and feature preference-based
campsites.
• Validate supplied date ranges and positive guest/radius values.
• Apply these criteria when filtering campsites.

div.div:
Includes LotteryOffer and lotteryEntry
Knows
• Owner, lottery details, registration/booking windows, and capacity.
• Offered campsites and nights.
• Entrants, participation states, and draw outcomes.
Does
• Represent lottery configuration and lifecycle.
• Validate windows, limits, and offered-night allocations.
• Track participation states and derive registration/booking availability.
• Create, edit, publish, and cancel lotteries.
• Validate owner permissions, windows, offers, and capacity.
• Manage entrant joining, withdrawal, and declined offers.
• Run and resume draws without replacing saved outcomes.
• Request result notifications.

Entrant, campsite, lottery win, stay dates, and guests.
Price, accepted terms, simulated payment/refund, and reservation status.
Does
• Display booking choices and reservation history.
• Validate eligibility, availability, guests, price, and accepted rules.
• Coordinate booking, payment recording, and night claims.
• Cancel/reject reservations, refund, and release nights.
• Prevent double booking and repeated refunds; keep used wins
consumed.
• Request notifications, CSV export, and reservation-map display.

div.div:
Knows
• Account ID, name, optional email and phone.
• Roles, camping preferences, settings, creation time and removal
metadata.
Account capabilities: ENTRANT, OWNER, and ADMIN; an account can
hold multiple roles.
Preferred campsite tags and amenities, stored as sets without duplicates.
Notification Preference and palette preference, font and control-seze
preferences
Does
• Validate that a non-removed account has a non-blank name and at least
one role.
• Derive isActive from the absence of removal metadata.
Provide default settings and validate positive, finite size scales
• Create a default entrant account.
• Update profile, preferences, and settings while preserving unrelated
fields.
• Enable owner capability without granting ADMIN.
• Reject changes to inactive accounts.

div.div:
Knows
• Current account ID, observed profile, edit draft and operation state.
• Profile, notification-setting, and camping-preference drafts.
• Loading, saving, and error state.
Does
• Load profile and validate edits; save through Database.
• Preserve input on failure and report confirmed results.
• Confirm removal and delegate to Administration
• Delegate image operations to the shared image controller.
'
• Display and edit notification preferences and camping interests.
• Save changes through AccountRepository, preserving unrelated
settings.
• Retain unsaved input after failures.
